question: In September 2020, who was appointed as Executive Director of Asian Development Bank, Manila?
solution:
The correct answer is __Sameer Khare.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Sameer Kumar Khare__ will be the new executive director at Asian Development Bank.
 
• Rajesh Khullar has been appointed to the World Bank as executive director.
 
• Both the appointments are for a period of three years.
 
• The Appointments Committee of the Cabinet (ACC) has approved the appointments of new executive directors for the World Bank and Asian Development Bank (ADB).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• ADB:

 
 
• Headquarters - Mandaluyong, Philippines.
 
• President - Masatsugu Asakawa.
 
• Founded On - 19 December 1966.
